findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Demliği bir kez Esçay’la kuran geri dönmüyor." → 3 lines (7 words, 72px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.
Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 3 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.relative.z-20 1440px | ol.mt-16.grid 1216px | div.grid.gap-12 1216px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Katkısız, yüzde yüz Karadeniz" 3.4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Rize ve Artvin bahçelerinden" 3.4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Tavşan kanı demlik çayı" 3.4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Rize ve Artvin bahçelerinden" 3.4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 82px on the left, 32px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Karadeniz çayı") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Yüksek bahçelerin altın harmanı." (screen 4, 25% hidden); "Gold Karadeniz, 1000 g" (screen 4, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Karadeniz çayı" (screen 2, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Katkısız, yüzde yüz Karadeniz" above "Yüksek bahçelerin altın harmanı."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 34px at 768px. Widest offenders: a.transition-colors.hover:text-brand (+34px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: No visible button in the first phone screen.
findings.fix: On a phone the first screen still holds the headline, the supporting sentence and the action; move navigation into one row or a menu so it does not push them down.
